case_number: 2024 INSC 802; CIVIL APPEAL No. [NUMBER] OF 2024 (Arising out of SLP (C) No.5660 of 2023) AND CIVIL APPEAL No. [NUMBER] OF 2024 (Arising out of SLP (C) No.12876 of 2024)
summary: Employment status of engineer under Industrial Disputes Act; definition of 'workman' hinges on nature of duties not designation; supervisory role salary threshold analysis; termination without notice challenge; Labour Court reinstatement upheld; High Court partial reversal on retroactive amendment application; pre-2010 Rs.1,600 monthly salary limit for supervisory workman; post-2010 amendment Rs.10,000 limit; termination with payment in lieu of notice examined; concurrent findings interference; back wages entitlement in wrongful termination.
final_judgment: Both appeals allowed in part; High Court judgment modified; reinstatement with back wages directed; termination set aside as illegal.
